description: Returns one Development Radio field guide as Markdown: title, publication date, page URL, the answer, the full text (the mechanism, worked numbers, how it fails in production, a decision table and a check to run), the primary sources it was checked against and the episodes that discuss it. Use this when you have a guide slug from search_guides and need the reasoning, numbers or sources behind the recommendation. Each guide is written with AI and checked against the primary sources it cites before publication.

slug.description: Guide slug as returned by search_guides, for example cache-stampedes-and-invalidation.

name: get_guide
title: Get one field guide
